text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Aptitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Skeletal structure. Muscle composition.
Each
racer is born with her own unique
form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the world of Umamusume racing,
finishing first
or last may come down to
whether you're fit for
that particular
track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Of course, aptitude can change with
effort.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But sometimes, the time necessary for
that effort
may be too precious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An athlete's time in the limelight is
priceless and
short-lived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a trainer, how can I nurture my
trainee's skills
so that she may shine and
succeed?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
These are challenges every trainer must
face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer is over. Today, I'm making our
final
preparations for the upcoming
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll finish warming up. A light
workout on
600 meters of turf should
be...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Nothing, I just thought I saw something
over
there.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: K-King! What should I do?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Special Week? What are you doing
here?

text_block_list.name: Main Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Special Week! I was so moved by your
fierce
performance at the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Young Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Special Week! You're planning to run in
the
Kikuka Sho, right? Are you aiming
for the title of
"strongest Umamusume"?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: P-p-please! Everyone, calm down!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... I'm sorry, King. I'm just not used
to these
interviews yet.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what should I do? Wh-what should I
say to
them?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I mean, all you have to do is answer
the
questions they ask.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Special Week! Who do you consider
your rival?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My r-rival? My rival... Ummm... W-well...

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It's been a good while since I've seen
someone
capture the hearts of the crowd
with their running
like Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Tourist at Food Stall
text_block_list.text:
Man, I really admire Special Week. She's
honest,
upfront, and super determined!

text_block_list.name: Tourist in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! And she's got such
good
judgment, observing Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I know! It's Seiun Sky, right? She's the
favorite for
the next long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Umm... Sei?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She did tell me she was going to run in
the Kikuka
Sho and the spring Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Main Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Is this your formal declaration
of
rivalry with Seiun Sky?! This is a big
scoop!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What?! That's not what I—hey! King!
Don't
leeeave! I can't do this alone!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're doing fine. The reporters seem
perfectly
smitten with your responses.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer. Let's finish warming
up.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's okay. I have better things to do.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't waste your time worrying about
her either.
The Kikuka Sho is just around
the corner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, King Halo dashes off on
the
600-meter practice turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooosh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She accelerates and continues to
increase her
speed even further. I think
I've discovered her
specialty...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... How was I?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me, I think I'm good enough
to beat
Sky and Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering her running from the past
up until
this point, one thing has become
clear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her specialty is her sudden explosive
power.
What she lacks in stamina, she
makes up for in
acceleration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may not shine in a long-distance
race like the
Kikuka Sho, but she would
dominate in a sprint.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What's with that face? I can't read
minds, you
know. Use your words,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
choice_data_list: 本当に『菊花賞』でいいのか？
本当に『菊花賞』でいいの？

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. It's part of the Triple Crown tour,
after all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As a first-rate Umamusume, I have to run
in it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She does have the ability to perform in
medium-
and long-distance races.
Furthermore...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I obviously have what it takes to succeed
in the
Classics.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I can run both medium and long
distances. I have
to... in order to be the
best in the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If I want to be recognized as a first-rate

Umamusume, I must do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The worldwide fame and success
attained by her
mother weighs heavily
on her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But she's not the same as her mother.
There are
different places where her
potential can shine.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I know where you're coming from! But I
have not
given you the right to broach
that subject.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I want to win the Kikuka Sho. I want to
leave my
mark on the Classics and the
Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready. I've been ready ever since I
came to
this academy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: My mother will recognize my talent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems there's no changing her mind
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her legs may tremble, but it's my
responsibility to
prevent their collapse
under the challenges
ahead. We steer on
towards the Kikuka Sho.
